description: The account service for ALX Connect, a platform matching developers by skill, experience and learning goal. Sign-up with email verification, login with access and refresh tokens, and password reset and change, documented in Swagger and ReDoc.
role: Back-end engineer: built the API with a small team
contributions: Built the Django project and the custom user model
Built sign-up with email verification and resend, login, and access and refresh tokens
Built forgot, reset and change password
Documented the API in Swagger and ReDoc
results: Complete account flow documented in Swagger

body.heading: What it does
paragraphs: ALX Connect matches developers with each other for learning and mentorship. This API is its foundation: secure accounts. A developer signs up and verifies their email, logs in and gets an access token and a refresh token, and can reset or change their password, all documented in Swagger and ReDoc.

body.heading: Built with
paragraphs: Python, Django and Django REST Framework with JSON Web Tokens, and drf-yasg for Swagger and ReDoc.
